justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/ec/ErrorCorrection.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/PDF417ScanningDecoder.java, and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/ec/ErrorCorrectionTestCase.java. The class has limited outgoing dependencies: it uses only ChecksumException plus same-package helpers ModulusGF and ModulusPoly. Incoming usage is also narrow: rg found one production caller (PDF417ScanningDecoder creates a single static instance and invokes decode) and one test class instantiates it; no other main-source classes reference it. This is not strong fan-in/fan-out evidence for a dependency hub.
